column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way My Little Sister Is In The Bathroom
Kirino～
No response, huh. She must not be in her room right now.
Kirino～
Kirino-san, where are you?
Hm? Do I hear humming? ...Sounds like it's coming from the bathroom.
Ah, I get it. I come back from my school trip, exhausted, and here's my sister, leisurely enjoying her bath.
It's not like I plan on sneaking a peek, so it should be fine if I put the Regional Edition Meruru souvenir on top of her clean clothes, right?
Nevertheless, that Kirino... does she really need to throw her clothes around the room after taking them off?
...Does she have any shame at all?
Oh well, I guess there's no helping it, I can at least put them in the washing machine for her.
......I-I'm home.
Ah-aah, Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!
Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!?
O-Ouch...ah, that girl... coming out and hitting me without warning...
She doesn't have to be THAT angry about it!
We ARE siblings, so a little peek shouldn't mean anything, right?
What kind of excuse is that?! Die!
...Crap, looks like I've gotten her pretty mad.
...I really screwed up. I'll just give her the souvenir and apologize later, in person.
After about an hour, I tried to find a good chance to talk with Kirino, but...
Yo, I'm really sorry about what happened back there.
...Look, I bought you the souvenir, okay? Come on, don't be angry.
You're being annoying.
Not good... she's still angry at me...
D-Don't be like that. Here, I got the souvenir for you.
